1.consolidated_definition: Adaptador. Dispositivo o aparato que hace compatibles equipos de distinto diseño, finalidad, etc. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Se hacen y venden adapter para canchas de baloncesto para categorías menores de 4 a 11 años (clasificadosonline, 27-06-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Adapter. Device or apparatus that makes compatible equipment of different design, purpose, etc. Raw anglicism, commonly used. Adapters are made and sold for basketball courts for categories ranging from 4 to 11 years old (classified online, June 27, 2005)
